title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Frontier Model Releases: xAI launched Grok 4.6 featuring frontier-level reasoning capabilities, while DeepSeek V4 Pro entered general availability across API and chat platforms.
AI Terminal Automation & Benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 3.0 evaluation ranked Claude Opus 5 Max at a state-of-the-art 43.5% task resolution score in autonomous terminal workflows.
Developer Ecosystem Integrations: Cursor enabled seamless login for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers, while Microsoft shipped Windows 11 system updates optimizing cold app launch performance.
Corporate & Sports Partnerships: Google secured a Platinum Partnership with Bayern Munich in a sponsorship deal valued above €10M annually.
Geopolitical & Macro Analysis: Discussions highlighted ongoing equity bull market indicators, high-skilled H-1B visa reform challenges, and US-China trade policy retrospectives.

items.title: @SpaceXAI: Grok 4.6 Frontier Intelligence Release
items.body: xAI officially released Grok 4.6, delivering frontier-class intelligence and reasoning capabilities at the same price point as previous iterations.

items.title: @synthwavedd: DeepSeek V4 Pro General Availability
items.body: DeepSeek V4 Pro is rolling out across the DeepSeek API and web chat platform, providing upgraded multi-step reasoning performance for enterprise and developer users.

items.title: @synthwavedd: Terminal-Bench 3.0 Benchmark Results
items.body: Terminal-Bench 3.0 results rank Claude Opus 5 Max at a state-of-the-art 43.5% task completion rate, leading rival models in autonomous shell execution and system tasks.

items.title: @petergostev: Unreleased AI Model Narrows P vs NP Problem
